environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instances behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in AWS. PostgreSQL RDS instance with RLS policies defined but the DB user 'app_user' is the table owner (created tables during migration). The HMAC secret is stored in environment variable sourced from a .env file on the instance. No API gateway in front - NLB passes TCP directly. The /internal/health endpoint is accessible externally and confirms HMAC configuration status. SET LOCAL runs outside a transaction block (autocommit mode) so RLS context is not reliably scoped.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 on RDS, app_user is table owner, RLS policies exist but BYPASSRLS is implicit for table owners
config.network: NLB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 5000
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_records USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) - but owner bypasses
